$comment: Expected rejection per invalid example: layer = schema (JSON Schema with format checks) or semantic (cross-field validator). 'match' is a substring of the expected error.

review-r4-combined.json.why: Review R4 case: validated, bbox type without bbox, no timezone, end before start

end-before-start.json.why: half-open window must be non-empty and ordered

invalid-timezone.json.why: timezone must exist in the IANA database

bbox-min-greater-than-max.json.match: bbox min must not exceed max

bbox-crs-mismatch.json.why: bbox is defined in EPSG:4326 degrees

snapshot-without-raw-ref.json.why: ingested snapshots need the immutable raw object

registered-source-claims-validated.json.why: only ingested snapshots can be validated

registered-source-with-raw-ref.json.why: registered metadata must not pretend to hold a snapshot

licence-usage-licensed.json.why: 'licensed' is an access tier, not a usage right

prohibited-but-authorized.json.why: prohibited use can never be authorized

unverified-but-authorized.json.why: unverified rights can never be authorized

authorized-with-no-uses.json.why: authorization must name the permitted uses

display-unit-as-canonical.json.why: MLD is a display/input unit, not canonical

non-utc-timestamp.json.why: instants are stored in UTC with Z

old-groundwater-capability.json.why: groundwater split into abstraction vs level

registered-source-with-snapshot-link.jso.why: v0.3: a registered source links to no snapshot source

uncertainty-without-value.json.why: v0.3: absolute/relative uncertainty needs a value

unknown-observation-method.json.why: v0.3: observation method is a closed vocabulary
